phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F4 Phase B — Exact Complement and Rank Audit
purpose: Determine which missing F4 holder-by-issuer cells are uniquely identified by Phase A observations, published W0/W1 controls, exact S12=F+BNR sector identities, and a separately declared stock-only BNR zero-liability structural scenario.

inputs.additional_controls: ECB QSA total-economy W1 F4 assets/liabilities, T/S/L, stock and transactions

canonical_variables: 35 in-boundary holder→issuer cells over H/C/F/G/X/BNR; X→X is outside the Romanian national-accounts boundary
equation_families: Phase A directly observed or exact S+L / S12-S121 derived cells
published total-economy W1 asset and liability controls
exact S12-holder identity: S12 holder = RMD F holder + BNR holder where the corresponding S12 source is directly usable
stock-only conditional BNR issuer zero constraints when the published non-consolidated BNR W0 F4 liability stock is exactly zero

stock_BNR_zero_scenario.premise: A zero non-consolidated aggregate F4 liability stock for BNR is treated as a candidate partition-zero constraint for loan positions, never for transactions.
stock_BNR_zero_scenario.required_source_condition: BNR W0 F4 liability stock must be directly published as zero on all-original-maturity T with no maturity conflict.
stock_BNR_zero_scenario.prohibited_extension: Zero aggregate F4 transactions do not imply zero bilateral transactions because positive and negative transactions may offset.

outputs: rank, nullity and unique-variable topology before and after the stock-only BNR zero scenario
exact row/column complement candidates and independent source/control residuals
explicit unresolved degrees of freedom for stock and flow
next-source requirement for any remaining non-unique cells
promotion_rule: This phase identifies algebraic uniqueness only. F4 materialization requires a later immutable-source-vintage gate and may promote only directly observed or exactly derived cells whose provenance and reconciliation are reproducible offline.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only recovery; no feedback loop, delay, behavioural equation or closure status changes.
